data.acceptance:
- Concurrent first-use resolution converges: N processes racing on a fresh
  store all end up with the same machine id, matching the persisted file.
- A failed persist surfaces as an error rather than being silently discarded.
- On a platform with no system machine id, the behavior when
  `.knots/machine-id` is deleted is defined and documented.
- Existing stores keep their current machine id; no store changes identity on
  upgrade.
